div.div:
Assumption: the discounts (customer, first order, subtotal ≥ 500) are added together and applied to the subtotal. Issue #10 does not say how they combine, to be confirmed by the team.
Return values of calls within :DiscountService are shown as "x = method()".

text.tspan: Assumption: the discounts (customer, first order, subtotal ≥ 500) are added together and applied to the subtotal.
Issue #10 does not say how they combine, to be confirmed by the team.
Return values of calls within :DiscountService are shown as "x = method()".
